system.description:
You unleash the fury of your blade as you spin, increasing in speed with each rotation. All creatures within your weapons range must make 2 Dexterity saving throws, taking your weapon's damage +2d10 on a failure and gaining 1 rank of Bleeding for each failure.

Chain 2: Creatures who fail their saving throws are also knocked Prone.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the number of Dexterity Saving throws needed by 1.
